lessons.title: Reading: Between Tradition and Modernity
lessons.context: A short passage reflecting on identity in a rapidly changing world.

paragraphs.uz: Zamonaviy dunyoda yashar ekanmiz, o'z ildizlarimizni unutmaslik muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi.
paragraphs.en: As we live in the modern world, not forgetting our roots is of great importance.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'p yoshlar an'anaviy qadriyatlar bilan yangi g'oyalar o'rtasida muvozanat izlaydi.
paragraphs.en: Many young people seek a balance between traditional values and new ideas.

paragraphs.uz: Bu jarayon ba'zan ziddiyatlarga olib kelsa-da, ko'pincha boyitishga xizmat qiladi.
paragraphs.en: Although this process sometimes leads to conflicts, it often serves to enrich.

paragraphs.uz: Har bir avlod o'zidan oldingi avloddan farq qilgani bilan, umumiy qadriyatlarni saqlab qoladi.
paragraphs.en: Despite each generation differing from the one before it, common values are preserved.

paragraphs.uz: Globallashuv jarayoni bu muvozanatni topishni yanada murakkablashtirmoqda.
paragraphs.en: The process of globalization is making finding this balance even more complex.

paragraphs.uz: Ammo aynan shu murakkablik jamiyatning rivojlanishiga turtki bo'lmoqda.
paragraphs.en: But it is precisely this complexity that is driving society's development.

paragraphs.uz: Kelajakda ham bu masala dolzarbligicha qolishi kutilmoqda.
paragraphs.en: This issue is expected to remain relevant in the future as well.

questions.question: Matnga ko'ra, murakkablik nimaga turtki bo'lmoqda?
Har bir avlod haqida nima deyilgan?
options: Farq qilgani bilan umumiy qadriyatlarni saqlaydi
